motivating_diagnostic: S18 (best entry so far, PF 0.884 development) averaged +0.78R on winners with breakeven/trailing activated at +1.0R and a 1.5x ATR trail. S19 tested activating EARLIER (+0.5R) and made things worse (PF 0.583): more trades were saved from full losses, but winners were cut far shorter (+0.42R). This protocol tests the OPPOSITE direction — a deliberately low-win-rate, asymmetric trend-runner philosophy: accept that most trades still lose close to -1R, but let the minority that work run much further before locking in profit, instead of capping them near +0.8R. Judged on expectancy/PF, not win rate.

hypotheses.entry: identical to S18 H1 (order_block_oi_confirmation_scalp, route='oi'): regime (4h EMA200 trend+slope, 1h ADX>=20) + order-block structure (displacement>=1.5xATR, volume>=1.2x avg, first-touch trigger) + OBV flow confirmation + OI confirmation (non-negative/non-positive change over 8 bars in the trade direction)
hypotheses.exit: breakeven+chandelier trailing activated at +1.5R (was +1.0R in S18); trail at best-price minus 2.5x ATR (was 1.5x); 8.0R hard cap (was 5.0R); 240 minute time stop unchanged
breakeven+chandelier trailing activated at +2.0R, trail at best-price minus 3.0x ATR, 10.0R hard cap, 240 minute time stop unchanged

single_variable_isolated: Only partial_r (activation threshold), trail_atr (trail width) and target_r (cap) change versus S18 H1. Entry signal generation, regime, structure, flow, OI confirmation, stop placement and position sizing are byte-for-byte identical to S18.
explicit_acceptance_criterion_note: This protocol does NOT expect or require a high win rate. A materially lower win rate than S18 (43-56% seen in S16-S19) is an accepted, expected trade-off IF expectancy/PF improves. The promotion gates below are unchanged from every prior protocol in this project (PF-based), so no special leniency is introduced for this hypothesis — it is still judged by the same honest bar.

symbols.note: Reuses the exact same cached klines/funding/metrics archives already downloaded for S18/S19 — no new data source.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid beyond these two named points. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Same order-block, OI, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S18.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
